text:
sam_sales: Heads-up 10am POC kickoff tomorrow with Meridian Capital. They want to validate SSO (SAML + OIDC), SCIM provisioning, RBAC role syncs, and domain verification workflow. Can we list what we can guarantee in a 14-day trial?

nina_se: I can drive SSO + SCIM setup. Supported: SAML2 (IdP/SP), OIDC (authorization code), and SCIM 2.0 with delta support. For trial we normally scope to a single primary domain and one tenant. Will provide a temp SCIM token and guidance on batching for initial sync.

trent_security: Security checklist: they will request assertion signing, optional assertion encryption, SCIM over TLS, audit log samples, and account activity retention windows. Ask if they require MTLS for SCIM endpoints. Also request their security questionnaire early so we can triage high-risk asks.

sam_sales: They attached a 28-page questionnaire. Not feasible to finish pre-kickoff but we should surface critical blockers. Lina, any product limits for role mapping or domain claims?

lina_product: RBAC: we map external groups -> internal roles. For POC we support up to 8 role mappings. Domain verification options: DNS TXT, CNAME, or domain admin email proof. Enterprise typically picks DNS TXT. Note: wildcard subdomain delegation is not supported for verification.

nina_se: Sample SP metadata to give to their IdP (paste):

```
EntityID: https://app.redwood-inference.example/sp
ACS_URL: https://app.redwood-inference.example/saml/acs
SingleLogout: https://app.redwood-inference.example/saml/slo
NameIDFormat: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
```

nina_se: SCIM endpoint: `https://api.redwood-inference.example/scim/v2`. We'll create an ephemeral token (14-day TTL). Supported endpoints: `POST /Users`, `PATCH /Users`, `GET /Users`, `GET /Groups`. Rate limit: default 120 requests/min for hosted. Recommend batching 100 users per request for initial backfill.

trent_security: For compliance artifacts we'll attach SOC2 summary and data encryption at rest details. If they require IP allowlisting for webhooks or provisioning callbacks, we need to check plan: hosted has dynamic egress; Dedicated provides static egress ranges.

sam_sales: Pricing ask: Meridian wants a POC not-to-exceed cap for inference usage and provisioning calls. Can we apply org-level soft quotas and alerting?

lina_product: Console supports org quotas and alert thresholds. Hard caps (blocking) require an enterprise addendum or Dedicated. For POC we can configure a soft quota to email at 50/75/90% and stop at a manual block.

infra_bot: infra-bot: Created POC org `meridian-poc-1712509876` and issued ephemeral creds. SCIM token pending assignment to `nina_se`.

nina_se: I'll provision SCIM token and prepare a small sample Python script for delta PATCH + retry logic. Sam 1 can you share Meridian's IdP metadata and a DNS contact?

sam_sales: POC contact: rachel@meridiancap.com. Requested IdP metadata and asked if they can add TXT under `meridiancap.com`. They estimate ~2k users.

trent_security: For 2k users advise delta syncs every 2-5 minutes with batched PATCH; also ensure our throttling headers are respected. I'll draft answers for the 10 highest-risk items in their questionnaire before kickoff.

nina_se: Will attach example SCIM batching script and SAML troubleshooting notes. Also will provide fallback Okta demo if we don't get metadata in time.

sam_sales: Plan: nina sends config & scripts to rachel, trent sends SOC2 + high-risk answers, lina drafts RBAC mapping doc, I'll handle the pricing cap conversation. Ping me if any blocker. :thumbsup:

lina_product: Also noting: auditing is enabled by default for the POC and retention is 30 days for activity logs. If they require longer retention it's an add-on.

trent_security: Uploaded SOC2 one-pager and encryption summary (link: https://share.redwood-inference.example/soc2-meridian).

sam_sales: Great. If no IdP metadata by EOD we'll stand up a temp Okta tenant for the demo. Closing thread after kickoff.
